name: ai-engineering-skills
description: Risk-based engineering workflows with explicit verification, safe execution and platform-specific references.

plugins.name: agents
plugins.description: Independent subagents: architect (design review of a plan before any code), reviewer (cold code review with a design pass), tester (fills test gaps, failure paths first).

plugins.name: ai
plugins.description: Build and evaluate model integrations, retrieval applications and bounded tool agents with explicit trust, quality and cost contracts.

plugins.name: architecture
plugins.description: Workload-driven system design and safe modernization without imposing a single application architecture.

plugins.name: backend
plugins.description: Backend conventions (layers, ports and adapters, one home per technical kind of code, allowlist architecture tests), contract-first endpoints, safe schema migrations and read-only data checks. References for .NET, Django, Node and Spring.

plugins.name: data
plugins.description: Data pipelines, database operations and reproducible machine-learning lifecycle workflows with explicit correctness and recovery contracts.

plugins.name: desktop
plugins.description: Native and hybrid desktop engineering: capability boundaries, IPC, packaging, accessibility and secure updates.

plugins.name: foundation
plugins.description: Shared task context, risk-based workflow and safe execution boundaries, without mandatory orchestration.

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Advisory command preflight and actual-index Git hooks with redacted results; host permissions and protected checks remain the enforcement boundary.

plugins.name: lifecycle
plugins.description: Quick, Standard and High-risk delivery workflows with scoped planning, exact-candidate verification and authorized release actions.

plugins.name: meta
plugins.description: Keep the workflow improving: create or update skills with a fresh-agent dry run, record architecture decisions, and turn a lesson from a real project into a skill change.

plugins.name: mobile
plugins.description: Mobile app architecture, a shared cross-platform core, background work and battery, an offline queue that never loses data, permissions, screens from designs, home-screen widgets and real-device testing. References for Flutter, React Native, Kotlin, Swift and Kotlin Multiplatform.

plugins.name: operations
plugins.description: Infrastructure, service reliability and recovery workflows with measurable budgets and authorized deployment.

plugins.name: quality
plugins.description: Testing doctrine, TDD, writing tests, code review with a separate design pass, security and privacy review, accessibility audit, performance checks, static catalogs (one row per case instead of repeated switches) and privacy-safe product analytics. Framework-agnostic, with stack references.

plugins.name: security
plugins.description: Threat modeling, identity and supply-chain verification with explicit assets, trust boundaries and testable controls.

plugins.name: specialist
plugins.description: Demand-led engineering profiles for public packages, payments, collaboration and specialized hardware/scientific products.

plugins.name: systems
plugins.description: Memory, concurrency, ABI, networking and resource correctness for native and systems software.

plugins.name: web
plugins.description: Web front-end conventions (pages, components, tokens, zero-JS by default, CSP, privacy, accessibility, performance budgets) and adding a page test-first. References for React/Next.js and Astro.
